about_the_game:
Dive into the haunting world of Chorus of Carcosa with this exclusive digital artbook. This carefully curated collection offers a rare glimpse into the creative process behind the game, showcasing the evolution of its visual style and conceptual design.

Inside the Artbook:

  • Concept Art & Sketches: Follow the journey from early drafts to final visuals, revealing how raw ideas transformed into the game’s eerie, immersive scenes.
  • Character & Creature Design: Discover how the protagonist — a tormented sculptor — and the enigmatic horrors lurking within the ever-changing building were brought to life.
  • Architecture & Environments: Explore the intricate development of the game’s shifting labyrinths and unsettling interiors, essential to its atmosphere of dread and mystery.
  • Inspiration & References: Delve into the creative influences behind Chorus of Carcosa, including Robert W. Chambers’ The King in Yellow, and see how these elements shaped the game’s unsettling aesthetic.

The Chorus of Carcosa Artbook is more than just a collection of images — it’s a deep dive into the artistic vision and craftsmanship behind this psychological horror experience. Perfect for fans of the game and digital art enthusiasts alike, this book pulls back the curtain on the world of Chorus of Carcosa.
